newsitem.title: UK: BFI down three as market continues downtrend.
newsitem.headline: BFI down three as market continues downtrend.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down three to 1,257 points on Wednesday.

Brokers reported Hoogovens fixed the Wah Shan for 120,000 coal from Hampton Roads to Imjuiden for July 1/10 at a very steady $6.20 but apart from some Atlantic Caper rates the freight market has generally continued to drift downwards.

New York reports that 54,000 heavy grain from USGulf to Japan had been fixed $20.50 no combo for June, down 25 cents from last done, could not be confirmed, brokers said. But the BFI panellists marked this route down to a roughly equivalent figure.
Conditions for Handy-sizes were increasingly difficult in the Atlantic and particularly severe for the smaller sizes.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 25 to 10 points higher and turnover was 95 lots.
